People: Gustave Aimard (author, Wikidata Q472068), died 1883; Lascelles Wraxall (translator, Wikidata Q5497002), died 1865. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Aimard, Gustave, 1818-1883; Wraxall, Lascelles, Sir, 1828-1865 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The flower of the prairie, Philadelphia, 1875, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/flowerofprairie00aima. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 75%, 94%, 90% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Lascelles Wraxall, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
